name: Matcha
rootCause: Matcha is listed as a frontend compromise on Base and Ethereum on 2026-01-25, with reported losses of about $13.43 million. The evidence available here confirms the catalogue classification and impact, but not the transaction path or the compromised component. Frontend compromise. The available record does not identify whether the failure came from a malicious script injection, a compromised build pipeline, DNS, or another frontend control.
